def.brief: Independent read-only review of rp-tests and rp-build by a fresh Claude sub-agent: it opens the contract document (.maint-evidence/record-paths-contract.md), the changed source (dwitbuk.py, hooks/stop_eyes.py) and the tests (test_dwitbuk.py) itself, runs python3 test_dwitbuk.py, and reports quoted findings; it changes no files. Fresh evidence beside rp-build's verifier accept, which read only one Grep and 70 lines of dwitbuk.py; that verdict stays as recorded.

non-claims: no check decides this task; done means the agent said so
rp-review: done on the session's word by name (`run rp-review`), with nothing of its own in the tree and no `did`
rp-review: done by the session's sub-agent — chongdae saw the session and the tree, not the sub-agent; its model is the session's unless the session dispatched it with another

trace.command-lines: kept in the local session transcript, not in the record
